Symbol Of Stunning (Spontaneous Symbology7 Ench): Rune stuns creatures in a 60' radius for 1d6 rd (save Will (DC +1) negates) when triggered for 200 min
Symbol Of Weakness (Spontaneous Symbology7 Necr): Rune inflicts -3d6 Strength on creatures in a 60' radius (save Fortitude negates) when triggered for 200 min
